titel: The Best Crispy Roast Potatoes Ever
zutaten: 2 kg russet or Yukon Gold potatoes
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
zubereitung: Adjust oven rack to center position and preheat oven to 450F / 230C.
Boil potatoes in salted water with baking soda until a knife meets no resistance.
Drain potatoes and rough up surfaces in the pot to create a starchy paste.
Toss with garlic-rosemary oil and roast on a large rimmed baking sheet for 50 minutes until deeply crispy.
